answer_1.quote: We propose a novel dialogue generation framework named ProphetChat which leverages the simulated dialogue future to enhance response generation through the ensemble of the history-to-response generator and the future-to-response generator.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Metrics. We use BLEU to measure the word overlap between the ground truth responses and the generated ones. ... We employ Distinct 1-4 where Distinct-n (abbreviated as D-n ) represents the ratio of distinct n-grams in responses. We adopt the embedding-based metrics (i.e., Average, Extrema, and Greedy) to measure the semantic relevance between the ground truth responses and the generated ones.

answer_4.quote: We ask three well-educated annotators to score 150 randomly selected responses generated by ProphetChat and other baselines.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators are asked to evaluate the human-likeness of the responses from three perspectives: readability, sensibleness and specificity.
